schemas.summary: Any of the four commands a consumer sends, with its command identifier.
The answer to one command, whether it applied, replayed or was refused.
A reserved-session control, presentation update or delivery command.
The confirmed effect or typed failure of one dictation command.
The non-transcript snapshot of one Shell-owned dictation session.
The versioned composer draft of one thread.
A compare-and-set write of a draft, stating the version it expects.
The outcome of a draft update, applied or refused as a conflict.
One project's identity: what a consumer prints above the threads it groups.
One item of the stream, either a full snapshot or a delta.
Which surfaces attend one thread, and how attentive each one is.
The narrow read projection of one agent thread.
